whatIs: This Tailkit page gathers the free sample of its Tailwind component collection: alerts, user cards, dropdowns, forms, lists, pagination, stat cards and a sign-in page, among others. Each one can be previewed and copied in HTML, React or Vue.js, and some also in Alpine.js.
It's a good fit when you need typical dashboard or landing page pieces and want to copy them into the framework you already use, without installing any library.
uses: Copying a sign-in form and adapting it to your React or Vue app.
Building the stat cards and pagination of an admin dashboard.
Testing the quality of the components before deciding whether to buy the full collection.
caveats: Only the free sample is here: the full collection is purchased separately.
The components are copied as code and live in your project, so updates don't arrive on their own.
They require Tailwind to be set up in your project.
pricingNote: This sample is free; the full collection is a one-time payment starting at $79 (Developer, one project).
idealFor: People who work with Tailwind and want pieces ready to copy in HTML, React or Vue.
